items.title: [ChristopherOdd] XCOM: Enemy Within - Ironman Impossible [YouTube Playlist]
items.description:
ChristopherOdd does a Let's Play of XCOM: Enemy Within, playing it for the first time on the hardest difficulty and with Ironman mode enabled.

XCOM: Enemy Within is an expanded version of XCOM: Enemy Unknown, adding new features and enemies.
